Definition: of Hebrew origin (H795); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine:--Azotus.
BiblicalUsage: Azotus is the Greek name for Ashdod, the Philistine city on the coast, where Philip was found after baptizing the Ethiopian — and from Azotus he preached his way to Caesarea. One city, one verse, and the gospel moving up the coast.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel does not stop at city walls, and Philip walking the coast from Azotus is my picture of a preacher who keeps going.
